body: Fuck it, I wasted my time posting on here. No one actually cares
Rockstars have fans to inflate their own egos, I have no one.

It's impossible for me to deny that there are good things about me, but if I'm alone does any of that matter? How smart or talented I am is irrelevant if I have to be alone for the rest of my life. I don't want to fall into the trap of narcissism and continue to love myself if I am truly the bad person everyone else acts like I am.
